claim.quote: Using data from the PICO-60 bubble chamber leading limits for dark matter masses between 2.7 GeV/c$^2$ and 24 GeV/c$^2$ are reported for the coupling of these photon-mediated dark matter-nucleus interactions.

name: Results on photon-mediated dark matter-nucleus interactions from the PICO-60 C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ bubble chamber

summary.plain: PICO-60 data re-analysed for dark matter that couples to light through electric or magnetic dipole-type interactions gave leading limits for masses between 2.7 and 24 GeV.
summary.technical: Effective-field-theory limits on anapole, electric and magnetic dipole and millicharge-type couplings using the 52 kg C3F8 exposures of 1404 kg-day (2.45 keV threshold) and 1167 kg-day (3.29 keV threshold) (Phys. Rev. D 106, 042004).

title: Results on photon-mediated dark matter-nucleus interactions from the PICO-60 C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ bubble chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract reports leading limits on these photon-mediated couplings between 2.7 and 24 GeV/c^2.
